nom: RoC Derm Correxion Firming Serum Stick

avis.texte: I love this! Im 33 and just starting using it. Within a couple weeks, my skin looks and feels softer, more radiant, and overall healthier. It really has been helping with pore congestion, which I really struggle with, too. For that reason, this is a new go to product for me. I hear good things about this brand.

I'll start by saying I usually absolutely love Roc products and have the entire line. But this particular stick is the messiest packaging I've ever seen, the metallic paint literally comes off in your hands and then when you try to smooth out the product it gets all over your face. That can't be healthy. It's very messy so I hate using it! Im about to throw it away but hate that I paid over 30$ for and no customer service to get it replaced .

This retinol stick has earned permanent status in my routine. Solid stick format is clean, simple, and precise Designed for the neck, but works well on hands too Gentle enough for sensitive skin Not sticky and layers easily with other products I originally bought this based on dermatologist recommendations, and it fully lives up to the hype. It's effective without being harsh, which is exactly what I want for the neck and chest area. I also love that it's ideal for travel — no leaking, no stability concerns, and no awkward containers. I've been through several of these, and always keep one on hand. Reliable, smart skincare done well.
Goes smoothly on face and neck and leaves a velvet sensation on the skin. I simply loved this product and most likely I will buy it again.
This was So much better than expected helps with neck sagging and wrinkles. .

I've used Roc daytime and nighttime cream for almost 10 years now. I decided to switch it up and add this along with Roc's wrinkle treatment. I dont know if it is this or the combination of all three products but my skin looks really good and feels incredible! This will be part of my daily routine moving forward.
Would 100% recomend. Specially for neck and forehead. It goes in smothly and you can just apply right before bed.
I believe it helps my neck look more firm and smooth. Will see if it will keep it that way

I started using this product every night after I took my make up off. I noticed that the back of the hand I was using to mix it on looked considerably better than my other hand. I now use this product on my face, hands, neck, chest, and arms. A little goes a long way, and I am very satisfied with my skin tone being more even, and just more yourhful. For the price it is definitely a must have!
Why did this form hard glass like shards of crystals on the top after 2 weeks of not using (as I was out of town and forgot to bring with me?)

I purchased 2 Roc firming serums. However, I find the product is drying my skin and there is no firming whatsoever. I also purchased Ponds Cream, and it is making a lot of difference making my skin look refreshed and tiny lines seem to vanish. Big difference in price. Can't see purchasing Roc again, wish I had not wasted my money.
I'm shocked at what I'm seeing with just two uses, product instructions indicate to begin every other night application, my skin is plumper, unreal, I can't wait to see the full results.

Ive tried many products and havent seen a result as rapid as i have with this serum stick. I have seen tightening in my neck and my jawline has lifted. I'm 56 and have been in the sun. I started skin care after seeing aging skin.

This is totally the one and only anti-aging skin renewal that works immediately. It has a good amount of retinol to work like magic on day 1 with no irritation, redness or sensitivity on skin. It has a beautiful formula that instantly forms the skin. I e en use it around eyes and it works perfect with no sensitivity to the formula

I noticed an actual difference after about a week (which never happens) my skin was smoother and mote even. I will keep this in my routine and use it in addition to my retinol since it doesn't say hiw much is in here. So far, no issues. I really do recommend this stick.

I have used this for quite awhile. I have bought 3 or 4 of them and loved what it did for my face. Yes it's greasy but it works while you sleep so not a problem. Until the last one I bought burned my face and neck... Did you change the formula Roc? I haven't used it for 3 days and my face and neck are still red and my neck is very irritated. Now I can't put anything on my face!
I use it on the top of my hands at night. BOOM my aging looking hands are looking less wrinkled! Use on my neck too and it's fabulous! Def recommend!

avis.titre: If you actually have wrinkles you should notice a difference
avis.texte: This is working for my deeper forehead wrinkles and smaller eye creases. I will be buying again.
This product has helped improve my skin under my chin by firming the skin

l've been using the retinol stick for a few weeks now and it's so easy to use. i feel like I am using my retinol a lot more diligently now, especially on my neck. it also dries immediately so you can add your moisturizer right after applying the stick and you're done. I will order this again. great product.
Maybe it's too soon to tell, but it's been a week and I'm not seeing any benefit. I like the way it glides onto the skin.

I have very sensitive skin.. However I can use this multiple times daily with zero side effects. Sounds like a great problem right ? But I question how it can contain effective retinol when it doesn't seem to do anything to my skin.
Really like how easy it is to roll on your skin. Feels so refreshing and so far my skin tolerates it.

Not a HUGE difference, but then I have lost some weight in my face and I am in my late sixties😬, so I can't expect too much! I feel it has lessened the saggy looking skin a bit and my face looks smoother, so I am very happy with this product.
I showed no difference in my faceDidn't do what it says it does

avis.titre: Bought it to help with my wrinkles
avis.texte: Noticed some improvement Haven't been using it long enough but like what I see so far👍🏼

I am very dissapointed in this product. I like all the other Roc products ive used But this product has done nothing for my neck or face. I will finish out the product becaused id paid for it but won't buy again.

This appears fo really help firm up and diminsh lines. Been using it nightly for over 2 weeks and can see improvemnts. Was using a gentle retinol before and went right to every evening use of this. I apply, let it set for a few mins as it feels water-like going when being applied. And follow up with a moisturizer and an occlusive on alternating nights. Seeing some great improvements.
I have used for 2 weeks and the roller ball has sunk so now it doesnt work, hopefully the store will take it back.
Easy to use and apply before bed. My neck looks great along with the skin on my face.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: This firming stick does what it says it does take away the appearance of lines and makes them less noticeable
My rating is because I love the way my skin feels. I am 65 with some wrinkles. It hasn't smoothed out any of my current wrinkles (yet?)
Disappointed in the serum stick! Goes on nice but it is just to sticky & after 1 month I see no difference at all & just got rid of it. So its like throwing money away cause it is expensive.
I've been using this for about a month. Finally a product that works

avis.titre: Easy skin care that works for aging skin
avis.texte: I actually can't believe how good this is. I have been using for almost a year and my skin is so much smoother and healthy. I am over 50, but I think it has de-aged my skin. The stick lasts a long time. I use it on my face, neck, and back of hands. If I were to tell someone to get only one product, this would be it

avis.titre: Great format for on the go; cooling, hydrating
avis.texte: I love this stick formulation. It feels smooth, cool, and hydrating. I can bring it to work and run it on dry areas of my face over my makeup during the day strategically, which is had to do with a lotion. I can't tell if it's a line filler or not, but that's seco da to it's convenience and hydrating feel.

I bought this serum stick at the behest of the Roc AI skin analysis for my sagging skin on the corners of my mouth and below my eyes, and have been using it for a little over 6 weeks. Unfortunately it's become a complicated like/hate relationship with this product. First off - it is a soft, solid stick, like a deodorant - not a "roll-on" like some users have stated. The likes... I have seen some positive results with the slightly sagging skin at the corners of my mouth/cheeks. My jawline was fine for the most part, but I think it looks better. And the horizontal lines on my neck have softened. The stick itself is easy enough to use and application is pretty straightforward. The dislikes... I feel like I have lost some progress made with my other serum - specifically, fine lines and wrinkles. The stick application makes it difficult to target smaller or specific areas I would really prefer the same formula in a liquid that can be dabbed onto certain spots as a true treatment. And, the hates... I hate how the product feels on my skin. It is sticky, does not absorb very well, and feels like it creates a weird barrier between my skin and my moisturizer which causes my moisturizer to not absorb. Kind of counterproductive, and probably why I have seen a decline in the appearance of some of my fine lines and wrinkles. Also, the swipe on stick feels like I am applying a ton of product no matter how lightly I apply it, and it will not run in because the product itself is sooooo sticky
Don't waste your time or money on this product. I use their products exclusively and was excited to try this one. What a waste of $$$. It's been 3 months with no result!

I tried this product recently. I definitely saw an improvement in my skin texture and firmness so I did upgrade my review but did not like the stickiness and roll-on application. Having previously working for Chanel Beaute, Christian Dior and others, I prefer a more fluid serum as I think its more easily absorbed.
I received this to try and I'm glad I did. It did not feel watered down when I applied it. I feel like my fine lines and wrinkles are being diffused. I might buy it again to have in my routine.
This product is so easy to use. It absorbs quickly and feels great!!
Love the applicator- it glides on so smoothly and easily. I don't have to worry about squeezing too much out of a tube. Still to esrly to decide if I like this as much as Strivectin

avis.titre: Instant Hydration, No Stickiness, super easy
avis.texte: Love it! I love how this ROC Hydration+ Serum Stick glides on so easily and dries nicely without feeling sticky. My skin feels hydrated and plump. I have been using it twice a day under my other skin care first skincare. I absolutely love it!
I used this for the wrinkles on my forehead and around my mouth. Saw improvement within a week! I definitely recommend this product.

I used as a trial recipient. Easy to apply and used twice a day. Tube lasted 6 weeks. Feels cool and not sticky. Fine lines on forehead and around mouth improved. My neck is markedly improved. Will continue to use.

avis.titre: Love the application of this serum!
avis.texte: I love this Hydration / serum stick. It feels cool and refreshing when applying, and makes my skin feel Hydrated long after !
I love the ease of application - just roll and go - no pulling my skin

I enjoy the ease of application of this Serum Stick. It is effortless to apply. I just don't see the difference between this product and the Fill and Treat Serum. Actually, I noticed slightly more improvement from the Fill and Treat Seum.

I use ROC products all the time and was excited to try this one, but when I did I was very disappointed. It was very sticky all day, it dried out my skin, my wrinkles looked worse and did nothing the package said it would do. I won't use this product again.
The stick applicator was easy to use. The formula felt cooling on my face. Like a mini facial. I use am and pm my skin feels hydrated
I have used this product for over a month now. So easy to use, works well on my fine lines and tighting of my chin and neck area. My skin doesn't look 71 yrs old.

Love this serum stick a lot! It is my first time using serum stick. It is so easy to glide onto the skin, and I can see my skin is full of moisture and glowing right after. I put on the serum before I go to bed and the next morning when I woke up, I have seen my skin is still glowy and moisturized. Love it!
Improves look in short term & treats in long term. Easy & neat application that absorbs quickly. I'm very pleased with my purchase.
Pleasant to apply. The stick formulation encourages daily use. Cool, not sticky, hydrating.
Applied after cleaning face in morning. Went on very tacky and did not seen to obsorb. Didn't really notice a change and applicator dried up and stopped eorking after two weeks.
Terrific serum and so simple to use. For anyone looking for a product that absorbs quickly, helps hydrate and diminish those fine lines the Firming Serum Stick is for you!
Easy to use. Very hydrating without being greasy. It is a bit sticky when first applying it but gets better over time.

avis.titre: Make this part of your daily routine!
avis.texte: This stick is very easy to apply and helps tighten the skin to prevent sagging. Feels nice on the skin and absorbs quickly.

I needed an effective product to target my chin area following significant weight loss and I see definite improvement in firmness and decrease in wrinkles after 6 weeks of use. This comfortable and cooling product applies easily and stays where you put it - thank you, Roc!

This product reduced the appearance of deep lines on my face. With many other products I often skip the evening application, but this is so easy and quick to use that I never skip. It goes on smoothly and is quickly absorbed.

avis.titre: Good for travel but not easily absorbed
avis.texte: While the serum stick is a good idea for travel, and the packaging is well designed, I still would opt for serum or moisturizer over a solid, because it feels like my skin is not absorbing the solid as well. My skin looks more hydrated the morning after I use a ROC serum. I imagine this solid is just as beneficial, but when I use it in the day, especially on my neck, I tend to follow it with moisturizer.
Tested this lovely product. Goes on smoothly and I use it after my morning serum. It's a very refreshing feeling and it really moisturizes the skin well. Will buy again.
I love the way this product feels, it has a slight cooling effect and is so easy to apply. You can put it directly on your trouble areas. Great ingredients that won't cause breakouts.

I like how easy the stick is to use on my neck and the back of my hands, and those areas look more hydrated after use. I have 4 instead of 5 stars because it's still too early for me to tell if this is actually tightening those areas especially under my neck, but I have enjoyed using it and have high hopes.

Lightweight, mess-free, and easy to apply. The serum stick glides smoothly on the skin, absorbs quickly, and gives a hydrated, refreshed feel without leaving any greasy residue—perfect for on-the-go skincare
Nothing comes out of my tube....it's dry. So can't comment without a product!
I love it, it works better than any other expensive brand name skin products, amazing, I see the results the next day

avis.titre: This is my second time buying this.
avis.texte: I saw improvements with my first purchase after a few weeks so when I started to run low I quickly ordered another. This is a very good product. While losing weight it's working great on my neck.
I have repurchased this product. It doesn't irritate my skin. I advise[use as directed] until your skin responds positively.
Keeping this in my routine! So easy to apply and already ordered my second stick. I use it on my face and neck everyday. NO irritation. I like it so far...lets see if I get results.

This stick is amazing on my neck. I use it morning and night. I then put my neck cream over top. I have never had an issue with the package peeling as I read in the other reviews. Try it you will love it. The stick lasts a while as well.

I have looked and searched high and low for a retinol product that won't fry my sensitive skin. This product, in my experience thus far, has been just that. When I use it consistently my acne and neckline improve greatly. Would highly recommend to someone who has a skincare routine that they want to add too.
Love that I found a great easy to apply product solution for my neck area.
I'm impressed w this stuff, I started using it for "tech neck". It's super easy to apply and I think the results have been great. I use it every morning as soon as I wake up.
I love this forming serum stick. It glides onto my face effortlessly.

Well you know we are always looking for things to do what they say they will. Well I can say this stick is absolutely amazing. Funny I had been in the sun just before I started using this. I had used it for only 2 days. I looked at my neck, it almost looked dirty lol...It had smoothed out my skin so much that what was covered with wrinkles which was white since the sun never touched it was now visible... I will continue to buy... If you are on the fence, go for it it really did work for me.
I've been using the same stick for a year, and now suddenly the stick has a sand paper texture.
I've been using this consistently for over a month and NO noticeable change. A true waste of money.
The product works. I do see less lines visible on my neck. The only complaint is the bottle. For nearly $40, It's poorly made. The paint started peeling and it will leave your hands dirty.

avis.titre: Easy application on neck and chest
avis.texte: Unable to use on my face as it caused breakouts, but I continue to use it on my neck and chest, and feel it has improved my skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this again for sure!!
avis.texte: I was skeptical with this product but I am very happy with the results. It's not sticky and absorbs pretty quickly. I love the convenience too. Swipe it on and done. A must try in my opinion.

Ive been using this for about 5 weeks. It definitely is easy to use, It DOES smooth my skin which makes the makeup go on better. However Im not sure about the Wrinkle reducing effects--the depth of my wrinkles and the amount hasn't improved. For almost 40 bucks, honestly Im not sure if I'll repurchase, as there are tons of retinal products,
I like that's in a stick form, it's easy to apply and evenly.
Its slick and goes on with ease I don't know how long it will last

I have been using this product for about 2weeks now. It reminds me of a solid roll on deodorant, however, it is not wet or sticky, nor is it dry, so it doesn't drag on your skin. It goes on smoothly. I use it on my neck and on my smile lines morning and evening as suggested, and I can see that my neck appears a little firmer. Note: a little….however, I'm hopeful that with continued use I'll see a notable difference. I'm willing to purchase products a few times, in order to see if they really work with continued use. I will apply this as directed for a few months and if I notice continued results, it will be a permanent serum in my skin routine.
This seems to be working well for me. I haven't been on it very long but seems to be showing signs of improvement.
I absolutely love this product ! It goes on smoothly & soaks into your skin!

avis.titre: I won't be buying this product again unfortunately-
avis.texte: I have used this product for one month and haven't felt any tightening or firming at all. I was wondering if I purchased a 'flat' or expired item. For me, it's a lot of $$ for such a small bottle that did not show any of the results that it promotes.
Money scheme all around. I've used for over a month and haven't seen any changes at all. Just out here lying to get hard earned $$$ the easiest way. So sad

I bought the product around April 1. I have tried many times to apply product. Have twisted it up and down. No serum vibes out. The applicator stays dry. I guess it is defective. Not going to waste my money on this product again.
Love the simplicity of the product. I put it on every night and my skin feels and looks great.

I recently lost weight that left me with crepey skin on my neck. I have tried so many different products without luck. I hated it to the point I was seriously considering a mini neck lift. I bought this thinking I would have the same experience I did in the past, nothing; but, I was wrong. It has only been a couple weeks and I can already see results. Now, not results like a neck lift, but enough results that made me go, dang this stuff really works! My skin is more taut through my neck and I have less wrinkles on the back of my hands where I have been using it as suggested. I am a user for Life!
My Skin Looks and Feels softer and a Major Visible Difference! Really Love this Product
This product is amazing! I could see a difference within the first week of using it! Highly recommended.

I absolutely love this stuff! I noticed a change in the firmness and softness of my skin after a week of using it twice a day. I love how easy it is to apply. I'm going to stock up while it's on sale!
I love this! It glides on smoothly, does not feel greasy, and feels a bit like a facial. My skin is looking great!

avis.titre: Great product and have a question…
avis.texte: I have just started using this product but have already noticed a difference - it works. I have mostly been using on my neck And back of hands. I do have a question though. Once you twist the bottom of the Roller do you just continue to do that throughout your entire use Of the product and do you need to keep the protective cover on the roller because it doesn't fit once you twist it up. I have given it four stars because I've just started using it and have seen results already - after a couple more weeks I would give it five stars if it continues to work as it has so far.
I'm almost 69 years old. I love Roc products. It took wrinkles away! Would you recommend a product with Roc that I should start using for my brown spots
The product seems effective however I have to stop using it because the silver paint on the packaging is flaking off into tiny specs and I literally have to scratch it off my skin.

avis.titre: First time with Roc. Not a fan
avis.texte: Using with Derm Correxion contour cream. No difference "instantly". No difference after a week. Sticky and tacky so I can't use it at bedtime.
I am in shock at how well this works! It goes on smooth and adsorbs well, not greasy. I'm 62 and get tons of complements on how great my skin looks since I started using it. Love it. Will buy again!
Love this product! already seeing improvements in my neck and hands.

Love Love Love this new product from Roc! The product is easy to apply to your skin with the stick. It doesn't irritate your skin if you are sensitive to Retinols. I use this on my neck and hands every night to help with anti aging.

This serum has truly transformed my skin, making it feel incredibly smooth and revitalized. The texture is luxurious and absorbs effortlessly without any sticky residue. I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's overall appearance since incorporating it into my routine. It's become an essential step in my daily skincare regimen. I highly recommend this serum for anyone seeking a noticeable enhancement in their skin's texture and health.

I really like the feel of this serum on my neck; it's smooth, soft, no smell. But I am not sure if I have seen any improvement for my "flabby "skin neck. I am going to keep using it because it does not hurt me a bit.

This really works! I have wasted so much money on products. I used this and my jowls started to disappear within 2 days. I have one small wrinkle on my forehead and it's faded. I highly recommend this!

avis.titre: Visible improvement in the first two weeks
avis.texte: I am impressed with this product! Not only is application easy with the roll-on packaging, wrinkles showed definite improvement in the first two weeks of use. I use it once daily, and though it can be used morning and evening, I've kept it to once a day because I've had reactions to retinol products in the past, and there was still definite improvement to face wrinkles.
I don't see any improvement, seems like just another snake oil
I can feel it tightening on my face right away. It is so easy to apply.
Love the way this glides on your skin (feel the tingle!) and the ease of application. However, it does leave the skin feeling a little tacky.

avis.titre: Does what it claims! Excellent product
avis.texte: I noticed a difference in one week of 1x day use. It softens, moisturizes but is not greasy. Will continue to purchase.
